questions.expected_answer: Neurological disorder characterized by trouble in forming letters and shapes.
questions.explanation: Dysgraphia is a specific learning disability that primarily affects a person’s ability to write or draw legibly and fluently. It is rooted in neurological differences that impact the fine motor skills required for writing and drawing tasks. Individuals with dysgraphia often struggle to form letters and shapes neatly and consistently. Their writing may be illegible, irregular in size, and may contain letter reversals or mix-ups in the order of letters within words.
questions.supporting_excerpt: Dysgraphia is a: — Answer: (C) Neurological disorder characterized by trouble in forming letters and shapes.

questions.stem: Teachers who are working towards inclusive classrooms : (i) Create curriculum adaptations (ii) Incorporate diverse perspectives (iii) Examine their own implicit bias (iv) See diversity as an obstacle Which of the above are correct"
questions.explanation: (i) Create curriculum adaptations: Inclusive teaching involves adapting the curriculum to meet the diverse needs of all students. This means modifying lessons, assignments, and assessments to accommodate different learning styles, abilities, and backgrounds. (ii) Incorporate diverse perspectives: An inclusive classroom values and integrates diverse perspectives, cultures, and experiences. Teachers should strive to create an environment where students from different backgrounds feel heard and respected. (iii) Examine their own implicit bias: Implicit bias refers to unconscious attitudes or stereotypes that can influence our perceptions and actions. Inclusive teachers recognize the importance of self-reflection and actively work to identify and address their own biases. (iv) See diversity as an obstacle: This statement is not a correct approach to fostering inclusivity. Inclusive teachers do not view diversity as an obstacle but as an asset.
questions.supporting_excerpt: Teachers who are working towards inclusive classrooms : (i) Create curriculum adaptations (ii) Incorporate diverse perspectives (iii) Examine their own implicit bias (iv) See diversity as an obstacle Which of the above are correct" — Answer: (B) (i), (ii), (iii)
